supersedes: The separate AmbientListeningService proposed in the earlier plan receipt.
Any worker-commission language that would create a second foreground service or second heartbeat notification for ambient listening.
preserves: Existing Home Center Android operator overlay lineage and application id com.homecenter.operatoroverlay.
FULL / BUBBLE / HIDDEN presentation independent from listening state.
Rolling bounded raw audio, rolling text transform, explicit KEEP-only durable promotion.
Visible user-initiated ARM LISTENING action and no microphone start from BOOT_COMPLETED.
Ritsu as default opinionated intelligence voice; optional approved voices share one structured seam.
Adam excluded from runtime labels, prompts, routes, aliases, fallbacks and recovery paths.
One heartbeat notification as authoritative recall/control surface.

research.source: Android Developers — Launch a foreground service
research.finding: An already-running foreground service may call ServiceCompat.startForeground() again to add more declared foreground-service types using the bitwise combination of types.

research.source: Android Developers — Declare foreground services and request permissions
research.finding: A service may declare multiple foreground-service types separated by | in android:foregroundServiceType.

Microphone foreground work requires FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE plus RECORD_AUDIO and is subject to while-in-use restrictions; a microphone FGS cannot normally be created from BOOT_COMPLETED. specialUse has no runtime prerequisite.

The public API documents startForeground(type set) and stopForeground(service), but does not document a symmetric operation that subtracts one active foreground-service type while keeping the same foreground instance alive.

selectedArchitecture.armMode: From a visible user interaction with RECORD_AUDIO granted, call ServiceCompat.startForeground again with SPECIAL_USE|MICROPHONE, then create one AudioRecord capture and fan it to ring + transcription.
selectedArchitecture.stopMode: Release AudioRecord immediately, stop VAD/ASR work, clear all unkept rolling raw audio and rolling transcript state, update heartbeat to OFF. Do not claim a foreground-service type bit proves microphone activity; mic_active is derived from the actual capture resource. The service may retain the previously-added microphone type classification until its next natural restart because Android does not document in-place subtraction of one active type.
selectedArchitecture.bootMode: BootReceiver may restore the specialUse control shell only if platform policy allows; it must explicitly mark listening OFF, purge stale unkept transient cache, and never call the ARM path or add MICROPHONE type.
selectedArchitecture.rawRetention: 10 minute fixed-capacity app-private PCM ring while listening; overwritten in place. STOP, new transient session, or reboot purges unkept rolling material. Explicit KEEP is the only durable promotion.
selectedArchitecture.transcription: Bounded rolling speech segments map text to monotonic raw sample positions. ASR failure must never stop raw capture.
selectedArchitecture.intelligence: One structured OpinionChannel above deterministic control. Ritsu is default speaker. Capture, STOP, retention and KEEP remain fully functional when the intelligence provider is absent.

antagonism: A second ambient foreground service duplicates liveness, notifications, lifecycle and failure states and violates the minimum-maximal commission without gaining Android capability.
The existing OperatorOverlayService currently starts foreground with the legacy untyped call; targetSdk 35 plus a microphone path requires explicit typed foreground promotion for Android 14+.

The existing BootReceiver starts OperatorOverlayService at boot. The rewritten service must make the boot path specialUse-only and listening OFF; no code shared with ARM may accidentally acquire AudioRecord during onCreate/onStartCommand.
STOP must be a real privacy operation: release the microphone and purge unkept transient raw/text state. It must not merely hide the UI or toggle a boolean.

Foreground-service type classification and actual microphone liveness are separate truths. Runtime/acceptance instrumentation must report mic_active from AudioRecord ownership, not from the service type mask.
The old 200ms UI polling loop, Spotify controls, Adam terminal/mode wall, RMS telemetry and screen-control clutter are archaeology, not mandatory recovery features.

venice.reason: The single-service design is a strict simplification inside the existing commission boundary: it recovers the old native service, provides the required microphone capability, and eliminates duplicate lifecycle/notification machinery.
venice.stopBoundary: This is architecture approval only. STOP_ALLOWED for the campaign still requires Regnet QA, campaign-machine canaries on the authorized phone body, implementation, build, deployment and the commissioned physical acceptance evidence.
